text:
good start, heres the next steps

the top of the cylinder is now one whole piece, which means it does not allow for breaking it up, but the example i showed you did allow for that. here lets look side by side again

theirs: [Image #1]
ours: [Image #2]

notice you do not see any edges in ours. how do you isloate the one and detatch? just double click it, to isloate the single piece in a grouped piece. 

next

we need to make it so pulling on vert is not just free by nature, it should snap to some grid space with a modifier for free pulling 


one more thing is you need to make it clear where the available space is to use, this looks like i have the full vertical, yet there is a invisible wall about half way down [Image #3]
resolution: Kept authored wedge structure visible inside connected UV islands, added double-click isolation of the exact face, snapped vertex pulls to whole texels by default with Alt for free movement, and confined checker/grid chrome to a strongly outlined real atlas boundary so out-of-bounds canvas space is unmistakable.
